name: cache-guard
description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm, keeps it warm while idle, reports re-cached context, and holds /model switches and resumes of cold subagents that would throw a cache away.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a response. Claude Code writes the 1-hour tier on this plan (the transcript's usage records show it); choose 5m only if yours writes the 5-minute tier.

minTokens.title: Smallest context worth guarding
minTokens.description: Contexts under this many tokens are cheap to re-cache, so nothing is shown or held for them.

guardModelSwitch.title: Hold cache-wasting actions once
guardModelSwitch.description: The first /model while the cache is warm asks for a repeat within 30 seconds. The first message to a large subagent idle over 5 minutes is refused once; sending it again goes through.

keepWarm.title: Keep the cache warm while idle
keepWarm.description: Starts each session with keep-warm on: a one-word background request shortly before the cache lapses restarts its timer. It costs a cache read each time; /cache warm on|off changes it for the session.

keepWarmMax.title: Keep-warm pings per idle stretch
keepWarmMax.description: How many pings to send after your last message before letting the cache lapse. Each ping reads the whole context from the cache, about a tenth of a rewrite.

contextNudgeTokens.title: Context size that triggers a nudge
contextNudgeTokens.description: One reminder per session to /compact or /clear when the context first passes this many tokens.
